color.description: Hex color code (e.g., #FF5733) or theme color (e.g., primary)

description.description: Description of when to use the agent

hidden.description: Hide this subagent from the @ autocomplete menu (default: false, only applies to mode: subagent)

steps.description: Maximum number of agentic iterations before forcing text-only response

variant.description: Default model variant for this agent (applies only when using the agent's configured model).

releaseDate.description: Release date as YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM

anyOf.description: Reuse a randomly selected provider until it is rate limited, then switch to another available provider.

auto_resize.description: Resize images before sending them to the model when they exceed configured limits (default: true)

max_base64_bytes.description: Maximum base64 payload bytes for an image attachment (default: 5242880)

max_height.description: Maximum image height before resizing or rejecting the attachment (default: 2000)

max_width.description: Maximum image width before resizing or rejecting the attachment (default: 2000)

Mcp.Protocol.description: MCP protocol negotiation. "legacy" (default) opens with the initialize handshake and speaks protocol revisions up to 2025-11-25. "auto" probes for the 2026-07-28 revision and falls back to legacy when the server does not support it. "2026-07-28" requires that revision and fails otherwise.

command.description: Command and arguments to run the MCP server

cwd.description: Working directory for the MCP server process. Relative paths resolve from the workspace directory.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

environment.description: Environment variables to set when running the MCP server

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

callbackPort.description: Port for the local OAuth callback server (default: 19876). Shorthand for redirectUri when only the port needs changing. Ignored if redirectUri is set.

clientId.description: OAuth client ID. If not provided, dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) will be attempted.

clientSecret.description: OAuth client secret (if required by the authorization server)

scope.description: OAuth scopes to request during authorization

enabled.description: Enable or disable the MCP server on startup

headers.description: Headers to send with the request

oauth.description: OAuth authentication configuration for the MCP server. Set to false to disable OAuth auto-detection.

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for MCP server requests. Defaults to 5000 (5 seconds) if not specified.

url.description: URL of the remote MCP server

disabled.description: Disable this variant for the model

chunkTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds between streamed SSE chunks for this provider (default: 300000). If no chunk arrives within this window, the request is aborted. Set to false to disable timeout.

enterpriseUrl.description: GitHub Enterprise URL for copilot authentication

headerTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds to wait for response headers (default: 300000). Set to false to disable timeout.

setCacheKey.description: Enable promptCacheKey for this provider (default false)

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for full requests to this provider. Set to false to disable timeout.

cors.description: Additional domains to allow for CORS

mdnsDomain.description: Custom domain name for mDNS service (default: opencode.local)

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for configuration validation

agents.description: Named built-in agent overrides and custom agent definitions

attachment.description: Attachment processing configuration, including image size limits and resizing behavior

auto_collapse_reasoning.description: @deprecated Use 'reasoning_display' field instead. Automatically collapse reasoning blocks after the agent finishes writing them

auto_expand_history.description: Automatically expand command history when searching

autoshare.description: @deprecated Use 'share' field instead. Share newly created sessions automatically

autoupdate.description: Check for new versions and show an update notice. Updates are never installed automatically; run /update or `opencode upgrade`. Set to false to disable update checks. true and 'notify' behave the same

code_edit_display.description: Controls whether code edit and diff blocks are expanded or collapsed by default in the VS Code chat UI

prompt.description: Custom system prompt for AI commit message generation. When set, replaces the default conventional commits prompt entirely.

auto.description: Enable automatic compaction when context is full (default: true)

preserve_recent_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens from recent turns to preserve verbatim after compaction

prune.description: Enable pruning of old tool outputs (default: false)

reserved.description: Token buffer for compaction. Leaves enough window to avoid overflow during compaction.

tail_turns.description: Maximum number of recent user turns, including their following assistant/tool responses, to keep verbatim during compaction. By default retention is limited only by the preserved token budget.

default_agent.description: Default primary agent to use when no session agent is selected

disabled_providers.description: Disable providers that are loaded automatically

enabled_providers.description: When set, ONLY these providers will be enabled. All other providers will be ignored

agent_requirements.description: Require declared agent skills, MCPs, and VS Code extensions before VS Code prompts can run

continue_loop_on_deny.description: Continue the agent loop when a tool call is denied

glob_include_ignored.description: Folders or files, as gitignore-style patterns relative to the workspace root, that the glob tool should search even when they are ignored (for example by .gitignore) or hidden. Patterns without a slash match folders at any depth; list a file inside an ignored folder by its path (for example build/report.json). Ignored or hidden folders nested inside a listed folder stay skipped.

mcp_timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for model context protocol (MCP) requests

native_notebook_tools.description: Enable native tools for reading, editing, and executing VS Code notebooks

openTelemetry.description: Enable telemetry. Set to false to opt-out.

policies.description: Policy statements applied to supported resources, such as provider access

primary_tools.description: Tools that should only be available to primary agents.

formatter.description: Enable built-in formatters or configure formatter overrides

hide_prompt_training_models.description: Hide Kilo Gateway models that may train on your prompts from model listings

instructions.description: Additional paths or URLs supplying ambient instructions

lsp.description: Enable built-in language servers or configure server overrides

memory_model.description: Model for automatic project memory saves in the format of provider/model. If unset or unavailable, memory uses the session model.

model.description: Model to use in the format of provider/model, eg anthropic/claude-2

permissions.description: Ordered tool permission rules applied to agent tool use

plugins.description: Ordered plugin enablement directives and external package declarations

policies.description: Ordered policies controlling access to providers, tools, and integrations

privacy_mode.description: Blur personally identifiable information (account email, balance, team name, etc.) in the TUI and require confirmation before showing profile details

provider.description: Custom provider configurations and model overrides

reasoning_display.description: Controls how reasoning blocks are displayed in the VS Code chat UI

reference.description: @deprecated Use 'references' field instead. Named git or local directory references

references.description: Named local directories or Git repositories available as external context

remote_control.description: Enable remote control of sessions via Kilo Cloud. Equivalent to running /remote on startup.

retention.description: Machine-wide session retention. Evaluated by the backend; clients only trigger runs.

enabled.description: Enable automatic deletion of old sessions across all projects and every Kilo client on this machine. Defaults to false; deletion is permanent.

maxAgeDays.description: Days a session is kept before retention deletes it. Defaults to 30, minimum 1.

server.description: Server configuration for opencode serve and web commands

share.description: Control whether sessions may be shared manually, automatically, or not at all

shell.description: Default shell to use for terminal and shell tool execution

anyOf.description: Additional paths or URLs to discover skills from

urls.description: URLs to fetch skills from (e.g., https://example.com/.well-known/skills/)

skills.description: Additional paths or URLs to discover skills from

small_model.description: Small model to use for tasks like title generation in the format of provider/model

snapshot.description: Enable or disable snapshot tracking. When false, filesystem snapshots are not recorded and undoing or reverting will not undo/redo file changes. Defaults to true.

snapshots.description: Enable snapshots used for undo and revert behavior

subagent_depth.description: Maximum subagent nesting depth. Defaults to 1, which prevents subagents from launching subagents.

terminal_command_display.description: Controls whether terminal command blocks are expanded or collapsed by default in the VS Code chat UI

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of tool output before it is truncated and saved to disk (default: 51200)

max_lines.description: Maximum lines of tool output before it is truncated and saved to disk (default: 2000)

update.description: Disable updates, notify when one is available, or install updates automatically

username.description: Username displayed in conversations and used for telemetry identity

warming.description: Keep recently active sessions warm with transient model requests (default: false)

web_search.description: Make web search available to models from all providers (default: false)

worktree.description: Directory defaults for local worktree creation
